static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: 与家人关系亲密但对表达Anxiety犹疑;对大学中的人际交往感到Anxiety并出现回避
static_traits.medical_history: not yet有类似心理问题经历;not yet接受过心理治疗;without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性Good,配合度高,Neutral attitude;语速与具体言语特征Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: '我担心秋季上大学后,人们会因为我讨厌意大利面而觉得I am strange,not愿意和我做朋友',这一信念引发Anxiety与担忧,并导致Avoids socializing与Sleep difficulties.
basic_info.core_demands: 围绕大学社交的Fear与Anxiety变得压倒性并影响日常生活,希望通过咨询获得支持与缓解.
growth_experiences: High school graduate后开始出现对大学社交的Fear与Anxiety,且随着开学临近逐渐加重;在想到结交新朋友或Attending social activities时,产生每日反复的担忧并回避相关情境,同时出现Sleep difficulties.
学业表现Good(High school以较好的成绩毕业),计划秋季入读密歇根大学;对进入新的社交环境的Anticipation成为triggerAnxiety的主要背景.

core_beliefs: 我与众not同会被认为很奇怪,从而not被接纳
Others' evaluations determine my worth and belonging

special_situations.event: Thinking about making new friends in college或Attending social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人知道我not喜欢意大利面,他们就会觉得I am strange并疏远我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social situations,尽量not谈及自己的食物偏好
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很怪,not会愿意和我做朋友

special_situations.event: 随着大学开学临近,反复思考not yet来的社交情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能融入,就会一直孤单并被排斥
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated worrying, difficulty falling asleep to stay alert
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be excluded after starting college, left alone

special_situations.event: 意识到自己与他人在食物偏好上的差异(not喜欢意大利面)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一个小差异足以让do not人negate我,not接纳我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用自我安慰试图压制担忧(告诉自己'do not人not会在意')
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not合群,会被认为很奇怪

special_situations.event: 回忆过去have not人因其食物偏好嘲笑她,但仍持续担忧not yet来的评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非有明确证据证明not会被评判,否则我应该继续担心
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视已有的积极证据,持续维持担忧以Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 即使过去not人嘲笑,我到了大学也会被嘲笑和排斥

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by peers, integrate into the group, and build friendships
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判,被排斥与Loneliness感
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing与理性自我安慰来降低Being rejected与Anxiety的感受

object_relations.self_representation: 可能被排斥的外来者/not合群者
object_relations.object_representation: A peer group that judges and rejects people over small differences

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及大学社交,他人评价或想到同龄人可能如何看待她'not喜欢意大利面'时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会像一个挑剔的评判者,对她的差异予以negate并排斥(移情:将内在的Being rejectedFearProjection到外部他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用克制,理性化的语气淡化感受,强调'这not是什么大问题/多数人not会在意',提供逻辑Interpretation以回避深入表达Fear与脆弱.

manifestations: 担心因小差异(not喜欢意大利面)被视为'奇怪'而not被接纳
对在大学建立新关系的Anticipation引发强烈Anxiety并Avoids socializing情境

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 在会谈中多次假设他人会认为她'很奇怪'并not愿结交,将内在的Being rejectedFear归因于同龄人的not yet来反应

positive_force: High school成绩Good,具备学业能力与适应资源
Close relationships with family, a potential support network exists
Willing to seek counseling and try evidence questioning and thought restructuring
negative_force: 对他人评价高度敏感,倾向读心与预测负面not yet来
Avoiding social situations, leading to limited adaptation

antecedent: Thinking about making new friends in college
Social cues as the start of college approaches
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心因not喜欢意大利面等小差异被评判与排斥,产生灾难化与负性预测,试图通过回避降低Being rejected的风险与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的负面评价与not适,暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced socializing参与,影响大学适应与关系建立

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep difficulties(Difficulty falling asleep,反复担忧)
antecedent: Thinking of college social life and others' evaluations before sleep
Time pressure as the school term approaches
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Being rejected与Loneliness的Fear激活,负性Automatic thoughts维持高度警觉与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 维持警觉以(主观上)预防Being rejected的假想风险,回避面对Anxiety情绪
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality,白天功能受影响,Anxiety进一步加重
